messages:
marta.p (PM): kicking off an RFC/PRD thread for rate cap + pricing semantics. need to lock on metering unit, API headers, UI surfaces, and acceptance criteria. aim: clear launch checklist and spec edge cases. :memo:

sam.k (SRE): +1. technical constraint: continuous batching and KV cache make per-request token attribution fuzzy. we need a robust definition of what counts as a billable token when requests are coalesced. also consider streamed/partial responses.

kai.b (Billing): from pricing ops: prefer billing by 'effective tokens' (output tokens + normalized prompt tokens) but we must document rounding, min-charge, and how retries/dedupe affect invoicing. also clarify committed units for Dedicated (GPU-hours vs tokens).

marta.p (PM): proposed PRD sections: 1) terminology & semantics 2) API spec (headers, events) 3) UI/UX for limits + recommendations 4) edge-case matrix (abort/retry/stream) 5) billing reconciliation 6) launch criteria + rollouts.

arjun.d (Design): on UI: show both short window (per-minute burn) and projected monthly burn; include soft-limit control (notify only) vs hard-limit (reject). show recommended default soft limits based on usage patterns.

cleo (Eng): implementation notes: we can emit usage events asynchronously to avoid sync perf hits. recommend headers: `X-Usage-Units`, `X-Batch-Id`, `X-Model-Variant`. we should also add a webhook for per-request usage for customers that need exact attribution.

sam.k (SRE): edge cases to call out: streamed responses (partial tokens if client cancels), retries (idempotency + dedupe window), multi-model routing (billing when fallback model used), model quantization variants (same token cost? or variant price?). propose dedupe window = 30s for idempotent keys.

kai.b (Billing): pricing semantics brainstorm: base unit = token-equivalent. pricing tiers per million tokens with committed discounts. options: bill only on final output tokens (simpler) OR bill both prompt+output (more accurate). need to pick and justify. also handle refunds/prorates for Dedicated underuse/overcommit.

marta.p (PM): tentative launch criteria: - RFC published + review comments addressed - SDK + header support in mainline - 2 customer pilot integrations - reconciliation test: runtime meter vs billing meter discrepancy < 5% over 24h synthetic workload - monitoring dashboards and alerts. rollout: opt-in beta (4w) -> gradual enforcement.

cleo (Eng): example API snippet to include in RFC: ```http
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <key>
Idempotency-Key: <uuid>
Body: {"prompt": "..."}
Response headers:
  X-Usage-Units: 1245
  X-Batch-Id: b-202
```

arjun.d (Design): UX edge-case: when a soft-limit is reached present two choices in the modal: degrade to smaller model (with estimated cost reduction) OR queue with ETA (with chance of increased latency). show price delta inline. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

marta.p (PM): action items: @cleo draft RFC by EOD+2, @kai produce three pricing scenarios (final-only, prompt+output, committed GPU-hours) by Monday, @arjun supply mockups by Monday, @sam produce reconciliation harness and run baseline by Tues. sync Wednesday 10:00am.

ops-bot: Reminder: RFC template updated — include "measurement method" and "reconciliation plan" sections (https://internal/rfcs).
notes: thread is focused on PRD/RFC drafting and scope negotiation for metering/pricing and limits UI/API. kept short replies and action items for follow-up.
